dialogue_texts: Coming from someone who thought they could breach my borders undetected, that's quite a charming little joke.
You may have bested both of us, but the Order will live on under Flandre Scarlet's rule.
I highly doubt Remilia will appreciate you using her little sister's name as a shield for your failing organization.
The Crimsonite grunts will dance in the capital of your pathetic kingdom.
The boundary between a grand ballroom and a pitch-black abyss is terribly thin, after all. They won't even realize where they're falling.
Berenice and I are done for...
Accepting your limitations is the first step toward wisdom. Sleep well beneath the dirt.
Thank you, My Majesty. The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo at this time is safe.
Keeping Gensokyo stable is simply my duty, though I expect your people to clean up every last speck of this dust.
I am very and truly pleased. I will attend the festival in Kozankyo.
How delightful. Perhaps I'll observe from the gaps.
I am finally happy to be reunited with Fusana. With the Grieg sisters gone, their forest of thorns has disappeared.
An expected outcome. Illusions born of stolen time always wilt when the master is cut down. Enjoy your reunion while the nighttime lasts.
They can no longer alter their fate, nor even escape and return to their own time.
The boundary between past and present isn't a playground for the desperate. Once you cross into the wrong flow of time, it completely devours you.
Using whatever time we have left, I can finally show you what our nights are like in the mansion.
How sweet. Now, I shall close the boundary on this incident. Enjoy your peaceful night, you two.
As I remark on the romance between myself and Fusana, our private ball begins now.
